sections.heading: What is this?
sections.text: This repository is a live demo of KB4IT using the techdoc theme. Source files go in source/ , and the built site is published to docs/ via GitHub Pages.

sections.heading: Workflow
sections.text: Write Markdown source files in source/ . Push to main -- GitHub Actions builds the site automatically. Published at the GitHub Pages URL configured for this repository.
